title: The Preamble
quote: Key to the minds of the makers - Supreme Court, Berubari (1960)

boxes.title: From resolution to Preamble
steps: Enacted **after** the rest of the text
Date in it: **26 November 1949** = ==adoption==, not commencement

boxes.title: Keywords
head: Word
Meaning
rows: ==**Democratic socialism**==: mixed economy; leaning to **Gandhian socialism**
Equal respect; **no state religion**; earlier only in **Art. 25(2)(a)**

boxes.title: Objectives for all citizens
items: **Liberty** of thought, expression, belief, faith, worship
**Fraternity**: dignity of individual + ==unity and integrity of the Nation==
⚠ Not in it: liberty "of action", equality "of rights", **Federal**, welfare state, adult franchise

boxes.title: Is it part of the Constitution?

items.what: **Berubari**: **not** a part; key to framers' minds
==**Kesavananda Bharati**: part; amendable (Art. 368) but not basic structure==
**S.R. Bommai**: secularism = basic structure; LIC case (**1995**): integral part

boxes.title: 42nd Amendment 1976
items: Status: **non-justiciable**; neither source of power nor limit

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Integral part case = ==**Kesavananda Bharati**== (APPSC GS 2025); Golaknath, Minerva, Gopalan distractors
Socialist, Secular added by **42nd** (G2 2023, G2 2025, GS 2025); not 44th, 43rd, 86th
⚠ other notes: Kesavananda first overruled Berubari; Golaknath a distractor
